topics.title: llama.cpp keeps KV-cache rotation constants on the GPU (#31073)
topics.why: Stops re-uploading Hadamard rotation matrices to the GPU; author measured +8.7% token generation on an RTX 3090 over PCIe 2.0 with quantized KV cache. Merged Oct 30.
